title: Migrate Http Web Request Mgt. callers to native HttpClient
summary: Six callers, including currency exchange rate updates, external accountant invitations, JSON structure retrieval, OData metadata download and the Microsoft 365 E-Document GraphClient, now use native AL HTTP types instead of the legacy Http Web Request Mgt. codeunit. A new CreateMetadataRequest procedure is added while the old CreateMetadataWebRequest stays for compatibility.
key_points: Migrated currency exchange rates, external accountant invitations, JSON structure retrieval, and OData metadata calls from legacy to native HTTP types
Preserved public API compatibility in ODataUtility by keeping the old CreateMetadataWebRequest procedure while adding new CreateMetadataRequest with native types
Simplified error handling in UpdateCurrencyExchangeRates by using direct error text instead of XML/WebException parsing
Consolidated duplicate telemetry logging in InviteExternalAccountant into a single helper
Changed internal InitializeWebRequest in GraphClient to take HttpRequestMessage instead of Http Web Request Mgt.
